notes.title: Meet the update!
notes.notes:
The 1.0 update has been released, adding Russian language voice acting to the game!

Many thanks to the cast for all their hard work and great patience - the work stretched over a long period of time and turned out to be not dusty at all :3

There's a 20% discount for the new version - don't miss it!
